# Sample tiles

`*.png` files here are served by `GET /api/detect/samples/{id}/image` and run through `POST /api/detect` with the bbox
from `bboxes.json`.

**Current files are synthetic placeholders** generated by `make_synthetic.py` and watermarked as such.
Replace them with real Sentinel-1 IW GRD VV tiles (256–512 px, 8-bit, same ids and bboxes) exported from the
Copernicus Browser, then delete the watermark script outputs. Real tiles with a GeoTIFF georeference need no bbox.
